visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright, naturally lit indoor cafe environment with high-key lighting. A man with short dark hair, wearing a black-and-white horizontal striped t-shirt, is showcased in a split-screen layout. On the left side of the frame, his hand gently pets a brown dachshund standing on a dark wooden counter near a large glass window. On the right side, he holds several small plush dachshund keychains and smiles broadly towards the camera lens. The background shows blurred cafe seating and natural light streaming through the windows. Yellow and white Chinese captions appear at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot behind a wooden service counter where the man interacts with a female staff member. She has dark wavy hair and wears a pale yellow shirt over a blue top. The man presents plush toys and blind boxes to her. On the counter, several bright yellow 'Sauschestra' blind boxes are stacked neatly. The background reveals a kitchen area with stainless steel equipment and a white refrigerator. The man's facial expressions are animated as he gestures towards the products. (3) The camera captures close-up shots of the merchandise, specifically a plush dog being held over a coffee cup with a 'BENKOFF' logo sticker. A brown dachshund is seen from the back, standing on a tiered wooden bench near a sunlit window. The lighting is warm and natural, creating soft shadows. More yellow blind boxes are visible on the counter. The man continues to demonstrate the features of the plush toys with his hands. (4) The final sequence shows a professional product display on a white bed-like surface with various plush dogs and pastries on plates. The man, now in a light blue button-down shirt, holds up a full set of the plush dachshunds while smiling joyfully. A digital overlay of a website interface for ordering the products appears on the screen, showing prices and quantities. The video concludes with a blue and white informational slide containing contact details and addresses, while the man poses with the keychains.

By combining personal travel experience with a clear call-to-action for a group buy, the creator leverages social proof and product scarcity to drive sales.
